Chosen: Blood, played in a modern engine
========================================

Chosen plays Monolith's Blood (1997) from your own copy of the game: Blood: Fresh Supply / Refreshed Supply (Steam,
GOG) or One Unit Whole Blood.

1. Run ChosenLoader.exe. It finds your Blood install (or choose its folder), lets you pick the add-ons (Death Wish,
   Cryptic Passage, MARROW, as your install has them) and extracts what Chosen needs into the data folder here.
   It takes a few seconds. Run it again after the game or Chosen updates.
   A mod made for NBlood (Eviction): press Add a Mod Folder and choose the folder it was unpacked into; it is
   installed as an add-on and listed again the next time.
2. Run Chosen.exe.

The data folder holds files from your copy of Blood: don't share it.
Settings and saved games: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Chosen.
The map editor, Chosen Forge, is a separate download.

Found a bug? Where it goes wrong, open the console (` or F1) and type reportbug and a few words. It saves
three files in data\data\bugs here (the console shows the path); zip them and attach the zip to a new issue at
https://github.com/MrPotatoStealer/Chosen/issues

Chosen is an unofficial fan project, free software under the GPL v2, with Ken Silverman's Build licence for
the game's ports of Build's engine code (LICENSE.md, licenses\). Its source is public; Blood's files are not part of it.
